features.name: record_id
features.description: Unique id of the historical stop-event record.

features.name: trip_id
features.description: Scheduled trip identifier.

features.name: route_id
features.description: Route identifier.

features.name: stop_id
features.description: Stop identifier.

features.name: zone_id
features.description: Weather-grid zone of the stop.

features.name: service_date
features.description: Calendar date the trip actually ran.

features.name: scheduled_time
features.description: Prediction reference time T — the scheduled arrival being predicted for.

features.name: precipitation_mm
features.description: Precipitation at the stop's zone, nearest reading at or before scheduled_time.
features.transformation: asof-join backward, tolerance 2h; median-impute + scale at training time
features.availability_time: at or before T (backward asof join)
features.leakage_risk: low — demo uses observed weather; production should prefer a forecast issued before T

features.name: temperature_c
features.description: Temperature at the stop's zone, nearest reading at or before scheduled_time.
features.transformation: asof-join backward, tolerance 2h; median-impute + scale at training time

features.name: visibility_km
features.description: Visibility at the stop's zone, nearest reading at or before scheduled_time.
features.transformation: asof-join backward, tolerance 2h; median-impute + scale at training time

features.name: hour
features.description: Hour of day (0-23).

features.name: day_of_week
features.description: Day of week, 0=Monday.

features.name: is_weekend
features.description: 1 if service_date is Saturday/Sunday.

features.name: time_of_day_bucket
features.description: Fixed 4-hour bucket of the hour, e.g. '08-12'.
features.transformation: hour // 4; one-hot encoded at training time

features.name: day_period
features.description: peak / off_peak / night, per the configured peak windows.
features.transformation: rule-based on minute-of-day; one-hot encoded at training time

features.name: transport_mode
features.description: bus/tram/metro/rail/ferry.
features.transformation: passthrough; one-hot encoded at training time

features.name: transfer_dependency
features.description: Count of other-route stop-times at this stop within the configured transfer window.
features.transformation: recomputed from static schedule; scaled at training time

features.name: historical_delay_minutes
features.description: Expanding mean delay for this route over all service_dates strictly before this row's date.
features.availability_time: at T (uses only data before service_date)
features.leakage_risk: none by construction — shift(1) excludes the current day; NaN on a route's first day

features.name: rolling_7d_delay_minutes
features.description: Trailing 7-day mean delay for this route, strictly before this row's date.
features.transformation: groupby(route_id).shift(1).rolling(7, min_periods=1).mean(); median-impute (train-fit) + scale at training time
features.availability_time: at T (uses only data before service_date)
features.leakage_risk: none by construction — shift(1) excludes the current day; NaN on a route's first day

features.name: historical_reliability
features.description: 1 minus the expanding disruption rate for this route, strictly before this row's date.
features.availability_time: at T (uses only data before service_date)
features.leakage_risk: none by construction — shift(1) excludes the current day; NaN on a route's first day

features.name: delay_minutes
features.description: Realized delay for this stop-event. The raw signal the label is derived from.
features.availability_time: only known after the event — NEVER available at prediction time
features.leakage_risk: critical if used as a feature — label-derivative

features.name: cancelled
features.description: Whether the trip was cancelled at/before this stop.
features.leakage_risk: critical if used as a feature — label-derivative

features.name: actual_time
features.description: Realized arrival time.
features.leakage_risk: critical if used as a feature — label-derivative

features.name: disruption_flag
features.description: Binary disruption label: mode-specific delay threshold exceeded, or cancelled.
features.availability_time: only known after the event — this IS the prediction target
